lines.en: Customer service, this is Elif. **How can I help** you today?
lines.pt: Atendimento ao cliente, aqui é a Elif. Como posso ajudar hoje?

lines.en: Hi. **My order hasn’t arrived** yet. It was supposed to come on Monday.
lines.pt: Oi. Meu pedido ainda não chegou. Ele deveria ter vindo na segunda.

lines.en: I’m sorry about that. Can you give me your order number?
lines.pt: Sinto muito por isso. Você pode me dar o número do pedido?

lines.en: It’s 48213. **Can I track** the package online?
lines.pt: É 48213. Posso rastrear o pacote on-line?

lines.en: Yes, I’ll send you a tracking link. It looks like it’s stuck at a local post office.
lines.pt: Sim, vou enviar um link de rastreamento. Parece que ficou parado em uma agência local.

lines.en: Oh no. **I’d like to change** the delivery address to my office, if possible.
lines.pt: Ah, não. Eu gostaria de mudar o endereço de entrega para o meu escritório, se possível.

lines.en: I can do that. **It should arrive** tomorrow before five.
lines.pt: Posso fazer isso. Deve chegar amanhã antes das cinco.

lines.en: Great. Thanks for your help. I’ll watch the link.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Obrigada pela ajuda. Vou acompanhar o link.

pages.title: Online Shopping and Delivery

situation.text: You bought something online but it has not arrived. You call customer service, give your order number, track the package and change the delivery address.

pages.goal: By the end of the class you can explain a delivery problem, ask to track a package, ask for a change and check what happens next.
canDo: Report a problem: My order hasn’t arrived.
Ask about tracking: Can I track…?
Ask for a change: I’d like to change…
Understand when a package should arrive
success: I give the information they ask for.
pages.think: Have you ever waited for a package that was late? What did you do or say?

teach.goal: Abrir a aula pela situação real: um pedido atrasado e uma ligação para o atendimento.
solo: Leia o objetivo em voz alta e peça que o estudante diga com as próprias palavras o que vai fazer hoje.
Pergunte “Think about it” antes de mostrar qualquer expressão.
group: Cada estudante diz algo que comprou online.
Mostre os 4 critérios de sucesso: é a missão final da aula.
extra: What do you buy online most often?
Do you read reviews before you buy?
support: Aceite respostas curtas ou em português na primeira rodada e reformule em inglês.

pages.title: Connection & warm-up

intro.solo: Start with real questions about the student’s life, then link them to today’s situation.
intro.group: One question per student, then ask a classmate the same question back.

pages.recall: Review: polite requests with Could you…? Ask: Could you tell me what you bought last month?

qs.q: What was the last thing you bought online?
qs.pt: Qual foi a última coisa que você comprou online?

qs.q: Do you prefer shopping online or in a store?
qs.pt: Você prefere comprar online ou em loja?

pages.tip: Use the answers to find gaps and to recycle earlier A2 content. Aim for longer answers: two or three connected sentences.

teach.goal: Entrar no idioma e ativar passado simples (bought, arrived) e preferências.
extra: What is the longest you ever waited for a package?
Do you check the tracking often?
support: Ofereça as respostas-modelo (chips) e peça apenas que escolham uma.

pages.title: Cultural snapshot — Delivery culture
pages.intro: Online shopping is part of everyday life in the United States. Look and guess before you read.

cards.note: Many packages are left at the front door or in a mailroom when nobody is home.
Stores send a tracking number or link, and you can follow the package by phone.
Many stores accept returns for a limited time. Always check the return policy.

qs.q: What do people use to follow a package?
qs.pt: O que as pessoas usam para acompanhar um pacote?

levels.A2: They use a tracking number or link and check it online.
levels.B1: Most stores send a tracking link by email or text, so people can see where the package is.
levels.B2: Tracking numbers and notifications let customers follow each step and plan to be home if needed.

qs.q: What can you do if your order is late?
qs.pt: O que fazer se o pedido atrasar?

levels.A2: You can check the tracking, then contact customer service.
levels.B1: Check the tracking first, then contact customer service with your order number.
levels.B2: Verify the status, gather the order number and delivery estimate, and ask the store for a solution.

qs.q: Why do customer service agents ask for an order number?
qs.pt: Por que o atendimento pede o número do pedido?

levels.A2: They need it to find your order quickly.
levels.B1: The number identifies your purchase, so they can see the details and the delivery status.
levels.B2: It links your request to the right order, which speeds up verification and any change or refund.

pages.compare: In Brazil, deliveries often require someone to receive the package at home. In the U.S., packages are often left at the door, so people check the tracking to know when they will arrive. How are deliveries where you live?

teach.goal: Ativar o contexto cultural: rastreamento, entrega na porta e atendimento ao cliente.
solo: Mostre os 3 cartões e peça hipóteses antes de explicar.
Peça que o estudante compare com o que acontece no Brasil quando ninguém está em casa.
group: Cada estudante escolhe um cartão e explica em uma frase.
Pergunte “Do you agree?” entre colegas.
answers: Q2: ver o rastreamento e depois falar com o atendimento.
Q3: para achar o pedido rapidamente.
extra: Have you ever had a package stolen or lost?
Do you read the return policy?
support: Use as respostas do nível A1 como andaime e peça que repitam.
stretch: B2: explique como pedir reembolso de um pedido que nunca chegou.

pass1.pt: Por que a cliente está ligando?
opts: She wants a refund for a broken item
She wants to buy a new phone

teach.goal: Compreender a situação antes de ver o texto: ideia principal e depois 5 informações.
solo: Esconda o texto. 1ª escuta: só a ideia principal.
2ª escuta: número do pedido, dia esperado, onde está o pacote, endereço novo e quando chega.
Mostre o texto só depois da 2ª escuta.
group: Escuta coletiva; duplas anotam as respostas antes de revelar.
Compare as respostas entre as duplas e só então mostre o texto.
answers: Pass 2: 48213 · Monday · post office · office · tomorrow.
extra: Is Zara upset or calm? How do you know?
Does the agent solve the problem?
support: Pause depois de cada fala se necessário.

qs.q: What was supposed to happen on Monday?
opts: Zara’s order was supposed to arrive
The store was supposed to open

qs.q: What does the agent send Zara?
Where does Zara want the package to go?
When should the package arrive now?

retell.prompt: Retell the conversation in your own words, at your level.

teach.goal: Ler o diálogo, perceber os chunks e recontar.
solo: O estudante lê o papel da Zara; você lê o da Elif.
Peça que reconte a conversa no nível que conseguir.
group: Leitura em duplas e troca de papéis.
Reconto em cadeia: uma frase por estudante.
answers: Her order was supposed to arrive · a tracking link · her office · tomorrow before five
extra: What would you say if the package never came?
Why does Zara change the address?
support: Mostre a tradução (botão PT) depois da 2ª leitura.

errors.r: I’d like to change the address.

pages.title: Useful expressions

items.use: Ask how to follow a package.
Ask for a change: address, date, size.

items.pt: O número do pedido, por favor.

items.en: I’d like to change the address.
It was supposed to come yesterday.

pages.note: Choose the four ★ expressions to use again and again. The others help you understand and stretch.

teach.goal: Escolher 4 chunks para uso repetido e descobrir a função de cada um.
solo: Pergunte “When do you say it?” antes de dar o significado.
Compare My order hasn’t arrived (agora) × It didn’t arrive (passado) e peça um exemplo próprio.
group: Cada estudante escolhe a expressão que mais usaria e explica quando.
Compare equivalentes em duplas.
answers: Reporting a problem · Asking about tracking · Asking for a change · Giving an expected time · Reporting a problem
extra: Which expression would you use on the phone? In a chat?
support: Trabalhe só 3 das expressões ★ na primeira rodada.

patterns.name: Asking about tracking
ex: Can I track the package online?
Can I track it by phone?

patterns.name: Asking for a change
ex: I’d like to change the address.
I’d like to change the size.
I’d like to change the delivery date.

head: Spoken English
Written English
rows: I am writing to report that my order has not been delivered.
Is it possible to track the shipment?
I’d like to change the address.
I would like to request a change of delivery address.
register.note: These are differences of context and register, not absolute rules: contractions are also common in informal emails.

teach.goal: Fixar 2 padrões principais (01 e 02); os outros são expansão. Usar a troca de palavras para variar a fala.
solo: Mostre o padrão DENTRO do diálogo (grife os chunks).
Use “Swap the words”: toque em cada peça e peça que o estudante diga a frase completa.
Compare spoken × written em 2 exemplos.
group: Troca em cadeia: cada estudante muda UMA peça e o próximo repete a frase.
Em pares: um escolhe as peças, o outro fala.
teach.answers: Padrão 01/02 são o foco; 03/04 são expansão para quem avançar rápido.
extra: Change the sentence: hasn’t arrived → hasn’t come.
Change one word and say the new sentence.
support: Fique só com My order hasn’t arrived e Can I track…? na primeira rodada.
stretch: Combinar problema + pedido: My order hasn’t arrived, so I’d like to change the address.

pages.title: Pronunciation lab — natural American English
pages.tip: “Fifteen” stresses the end (fif-TEEN). “Fifty” stresses the beginning (FIF-ty). In order numbers and prices, this difference matters. The goal is to be clear, not to remove your accent.

items.linked: Your ORder NUMber is FORty-eight, two-THIR-teen.

own.prompt: Write your phone number or a price using one -teen and one -ty number.
own.criteria: Say it twice. Can your partner write exactly what they hear?

teach.goal: UM só fenômeno: números -teen × -ty (acento da palavra).
solo: 3 passagens: escutar e identificar → reproduzir ritmo → usar com números próprios (CEP, preço, número do pedido).
Modele devagar e normal; peça que o estudante bata palmas na sílaba forte.
group: Coro, depois duplas; um dita, o outro escreve.
Cada estudante dita um número próprio.
support: Reduza a velocidade e conte as batidas em voz alta.

levels.h: Controlled practice — choose the best answer

items.q: 1. Your package is late. You call the store.
items.why: hasn’t arrived + yet describes a late delivery now.

items.q: 2. You want to follow your package online.
opts: Can I track the package online?

items.q: 3. You need the package to go to your office.
opts: I’d like to change the delivery address.
items.why: I’d like to change + noun is polite.

items.q: 4. The agent says: “It should arrive tomorrow.” What does it mean?

levels.h: Guided practice — complete, substitute and transform

items.instr: Say you want to change the size:
ans: I’d like to change the size.
I’d like to change the size, please.
items.model: I’d like to change the size.

items.instr: Make a sentence about a late package:

items.npc: Can you give me your order number?
opts: Yes, I give you the number is.
items.why: Answer directly and give the number.

teach.goal: Do controlado ao guiado: completar, substituir e transformar antes da fala livre.
solo: Peça que o estudante justifique cada resposta.
Se acertar rápido, peça a versão mais informal ou mais educada.
group: Resolvam em duplas e comparem antes de revelar.
Equipes: ponto por resposta justificada.
answers: 1: My order hasn’t arrived yet. · 2: Can I track the package online? · 3: I’d like to change the delivery address. · 4: Tomorrow is the expected day.
Gap: arrived · track · I’d like to change the size. · My shoes haven’t arrived yet. · Sure, it’s 48213.
extra: Say each correct answer aloud with the right stress.
support: Ofereça o banco de palavras (chips) nas lacunas.

errors.r: My order didn’t arrive. / My order hasn’t arrived.

pages.title: Personalized roleplay — call customer service

brief.teacher: You are the customer service agent (change the plan during the call!).
brief.student: You are the customer: your order is late. Explain the problem and ask for a solution.

orders: A pair of shoes that hasn’t arrived
A phone case delivered to the wrong address
A jacket in the wrong size
complications: The agent can’t find your order number.
The package is still at a warehouse.
You need the delivery to go to another address.
The agent offers a refund, but you prefer the item.

teach.goal: Simulação com complicação inesperada e três rodadas com menos apoio.
solo: Combine o cenário com uma compra real do aluno.
Rodada 1: com chunks. Rodada 2: só palavras-chave. Rodada 3: sem roteiro.
Meta de fala: 60–70% do tempo para o estudante. Anote 2–3 correções para a devolutiva.
extra: What if the agent says the package is lost?
support: Volte à rodada 1 se travar; peça que repita só a primeira frase.
stretch: Peça reembolso ou envio de um novo pacote e pergunte pelo prazo.

rounds.title: Report the problem
rounds.task: Your order is late. Call the agent and explain.
rounds.hint: My order hasn’t arrived. / It was supposed to…

rounds.title: Ask for information
rounds.task: Ask about tracking and the arrival time.
rounds.hint: Can I track…? / When should it arrive?

rounds.title: Ask for a change
rounds.task: Change the address or the date.
rounds.hint: I’d like to change… / Is that possible?

rounds.title: Share solutions
rounds.task: Whole group: each pair shares the best solution.

infogap.title: Package status
infogap.instr: Ask your partner and complete your card. Do not look at the other card!

a.title: Customer has the order
a.task: You know the item and the order number. Ask about the rest.

b.title: Agent has the tracking
b.task: You know where it is and the new date. Ask about the rest.

teach.goal: Fluência por repetição da função com informações novas a cada rodada.
group: Troque os pares a cada rodada (A+B / C+D → A+C / B+D → A+D / B+C → grupo todo). Com 6 estudantes, três duplas simultâneas.
Sem salas simultâneas: interações sequenciais enquanto uma dupla apresenta.
Responsabilidade individual: cada aluno faz ≥1 pergunta e ≥1 resposta.
answers: Info gap: A tem mochila azul e pedido 73604; B tem local (agência) e chegada (sexta antes do meio-dia). Cada um completa perguntando.
extra: What is the order number?
Where is the package now?
support: Entregue frases-modelo no chat da turma.

errors.w: The package is in the post office now.
errors.r: It’s at a local post office.

pages.title: Group mission — solve a delivery problem
pages.goal: Each group must solve a delivery problem in English: explain, ask, change something and confirm.

missions.mission: A package was supposed to arrive three days ago. Find where it is and agree on a new delivery time.
missions.constraint: Use “My order hasn’t arrived” and “Can I track…?”

missions.mission: You will be away on Friday. Change the delivery address to a neighbor or your office.
missions.constraint: Use “I’d like to change…” and ask for a confirmation.

missions.mission: The wrong size arrived. Ask to change it and ask how long it will take.
missions.constraint: Give the order number and ask “How long will it take?”
missions.start: Hi, I received the wrong size…

teach.goal: Realizar algo com o inglês: o objetivo é resolver, não só falar certo.
group: Cada grupo recebe papéis, restrição e missão. Alterne cliente e atendente.
Progressão: 1ª rodada com frases de apoio, 2ª só palavras-chave, 3ª sem roteiro.
Observe e anote 2–3 correções prioritárias; devolutiva no fim.
answers: Modelo: “My order hasn’t arrived yet.” → “Can you give me the order number?” → “It’s 73604. Can I track it?” → “It should arrive Friday.”
extra: What if the agent can’t help you?
support: Dê o início de frase (“Start with”) em cada cartão.

pages.title: Writing — a small real-life task
pages.task: Write a short message to customer service about a late order. Give the order number, explain the problem and ask for a solution.
pages.model: Hello, **my order hasn’t arrived** yet. The order number is 73604, and it was supposed to come on Monday. **I’d like to change** the delivery address to my office. **It should arrive** before Friday. Could you confirm that, please? Thank you.
checklist: I explained the problem and gave the order number.
I asked for a solution politely.
pages.tip: Fix only 2–3 priority points. Show a more natural way to say the same idea instead of rewriting everything.

teach.goal: Produção escrita curta ligada à situação comunicativa.
solo: Peça a mensagem; corrija 2–3 pontos prioritários e mostre uma forma mais natural.
group: Cada estudante escreve; depois troquem os textos entre colegas e corrijam em duplas.
extra: Add a second request: a refund or a faster delivery.
support: Dê o modelo e peça só para trocar os dados.

errors.r: Could you help me with this, please?

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.desc: Mantém a comunicação sem interrupções excessivas.

criteria.name: Language use
criteria.desc: Utiliza adequadamente padrões, vocabulário e expressões.

criteria.name: Pronunciation
criteria.desc: É compreensível e usa ritmo e entonação adequados.

criteria.name: Interaction
criteria.desc: Responde, pergunta, esclarece e desenvolve a conversa.

interpret.text: Needs more support. Revisit the main patterns with guided practice before the next lesson.
Functional performance. Work on the lowest criteria in the next lesson.
Good control. Raise complexity and speed; add follow-up questions.
Strong performance. Move to a more demanding situation.

prompts.well: Example: You explained the problem and gave the order number clearly.
prompts.improve: Example: Say “fifteen” and “fifty” with different stress.
prompts.next: Example: Ask for a refund and a new delivery date in the same call, without notes.

teach.goal: Avaliar o que o aluno conseguiu comunicar, não só os erros gramaticais. Observe se o aluno conseguiu dar e entender números e datas.
solo: O estudante se autoavalia primeiro; depois você.
Feche com os três blocos: What you did well · What to improve · Your next challenge.
group: Dê um comentário por critério a cada estudante.
Cada um escolhe o próprio próximo desafio.
teach.answers: A rubrica é uma ferramenta interna de acompanhamento, não uma certificação CEFR.

tasks.name: Report a problem

tasks.name: Ask about tracking

tasks.model: Can I track the package online?

items: Record a 45–60 second audio simulating a call about a late order.
Write a short message to customer service with an order number.
Review the four ★ expressions and write two examples for each.
Listen to the dialogue again and write down the numbers and days you hear.

teach.goal: Toda aula termina com uma produção observável.
solo: Sem consultar as anotações: relatar um problema, perguntar sobre rastreamento e pedir uma mudança.
group: Exit challenge individual; compare com o colega e combine a tarefa de continuidade.
answers: My order hasn’t arrived yet. · Can I track the package online? · I’d like to change the delivery address to my office.
extra: Revisão espaçada: retomar na próxima aula, depois de uma semana e na missão de encerramento da unidade.

pages.title: Level up — the same situation from A1 to C2
pages.intro: The structure stays the same; language complexity and autonomy grow.

ladder.goal: Say it with short phrases and models.

ladder.say: My order hasn’t arrived yet. Can I track it?
ladder.goal: Report a problem and ask for a solution.

ladder.say: My order was supposed to arrive on Monday, but it’s still not here. Could you check what happened?
ladder.goal: Explain and compare options with connectors.

ladder.say: I’d appreciate it if you could look into my order, since the tracking hasn’t been updated in three days.
ladder.goal: Negotiate with nuance and appropriate register.

ladder.say: Given that the package appears to be stuck, I’d like to know whether a replacement or a refund would be quicker.
I’d rather not wait any longer, so I’d be grateful if you could expedite a replacement or process a refund.
ladder.goal: Manage the situation with precision and tact.

pages.note: This progression is illustrative: complex sentences do not define a level on their own. CEFR also considers comprehension, autonomy, fluency, accuracy, interaction and appropriateness.

teach.goal: Mostrar a progressão sem criar seis metodologias.
solo: Mostre onde o estudante está e a próxima etapa.
group: Cada um escolhe a frase do próprio nível e a do próximo.
